name: docket
description: Take documents through numbered collections and collaborative review to a frozen, immutable archive

interface.longDescription: Organize documents into numbered collections and take each through collaborative review to an immutable form: drafted where people comment (Notion, Google Docs, or a plain pull request), moved through named stages, and frozen into a hashed markdown snapshot in the collection's archive repo. After that the text never changes - corrections are dated errata lines, and substantive change is a new document that marks the old one superseded.
capabilities: Allocate the next number in a collection and open the draft
Report a document's stage, backend and open threads
Freeze a document into a hashed, immutable archive snapshot
Supersede a frozen document and record errata without editing it
defaultPrompt: Start a new RFC in the rfc collection about connection pooling.
Where does rfc 4 stand - any open threads?
Freeze rfc 4; the discussion is resolved.
